# PromptSuggestions

A set of suggested prompts, each with a label and an optional description and icon; choosing one calls
`onSelect`. Use it in the empty state of a conversation or below a reply.

**Interaction**: every suggestion is a button with a neutral fill; hover and press add the shared state layer, `Tab`
moves between them and shows the focus ring, and `Enter` / `Space` choose. Disabled suggestions have a lower
opacity and do nothing; with `disabledReason` they stay focusable and show the reason on hover or focus.

**Category**: AI · **Common uses**: Starter prompts of an empty chat, follow-up questions after a reply

## Import

```ts
import { PromptSuggestions } from 'vellum-ui'
```

## Basic usage

Suggestions in rows that wrap; choosing one with a click, `Enter` or `Space` calls `onSelect`.

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react'
import { PromptSuggestions, Stack, Text } from 'vellum-ui'

export function Basic() {
  const [chosen, setChosen] = useState('')
  return (
    <Stack gap={3}>
      <PromptSuggestions
        items={[
          { key: 'plan', label: 'Plan the launch', icon: 'sparkles' },
          { key: 'notes', label: 'Summarize the meeting notes', icon: 'file-text' },
          { key: 'mail', label: 'Draft a status update', icon: 'message' },
          { key: 'files', label: 'Find recent files', icon: 'search' },
        ]}
        onSelect={(s) => setChosen(s.label)}
      />
      <Text tone="tertiary" size="sm">
        Chosen: {chosen || '—'}
      </Text>
    </Stack>
  )
}
```

## Variants

### Vertical with descriptions

`layout="vertical"` stacks the suggestions with the full width, which suits longer texts. A disabled suggestion
with `disabledReason` stays focusable and explains why.

```tsx
import { PromptSuggestions } from 'vellum-ui'

export function Vertical() {
  return (
    <PromptSuggestions
      layout="vertical"
      items={[
        {
          key: 'review',
          label: 'Review the design brief',
          description: 'Point out missing goals and open questions',
          icon: 'file-text',
        },
        {
          key: 'timeline',
          label: 'Turn the plan into a timeline',
          description: 'A table with owners and dates',
          icon: 'calendar',
        },
        {
          key: 'export',
          label: 'Export the conversation',
          description: 'As a PDF file',
          icon: 'download',
          disabled: true,
          disabledReason: 'Exports are turned off for this workspace',
        },
      ]}
    />
  )
}
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default | Required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `readonly PromptSuggestion[]` | The suggestions. | — | Yes |
| `onSelect` | `(item: PromptSuggestion) => void` | Called when a suggestion is chosen with a click, `Enter` or `Space`. | — | No |
| `layout` | `'wrap' \| 'vertical'` | `wrap` places the suggestions in rows that wrap; `vertical` stacks them in one column with the full width. | `'wrap'` | No |
| `aria-label` | `string` | Accessible name of the list; "Suggestions" by default. | — | No |

Also accepts `testId` (rendered as `data-testid`), `aria-label`, `role` and `id`, like all primitives.

Does not accept `style` or `className`: appearance is adjusted only through the semantic props above and the theme.

## Types

Types of this library used above. Import them with `import type { … } from 'vellum-ui'`.

### PromptSuggestion

One suggestion.

| Field | Type | Description | Default | Required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `key` | `string` | Stable key. | — | Yes |
| `label` | `string` | The suggestion, such as the question it asks. | — | Yes |
| `description` | `string` | Secondary text below the label. | — | No |
| `icon` | `IconName` | Icon before the text. | — | No |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | Disables the suggestion. | — | No |
| `disabledReason` | `string` | Disabled reason, shown on hover or keyboard focus while `disabled`; the suggestion stays focusable. | — | No |

### IconName

Name of a registered icon. Only the icons listed here can be used; they are Lucide icons under shorter names
(`trash` is Lucide's `Trash2`, `more` is `Ellipsis`). All names at runtime: `iconNames`.

118 values, listed on the [Icon](Icon.md#types) page.
